propositions: A declared-none file impact scope should cause signed plan review attestations to skip whole-HEAD drift and remain valid after unrelated commits
Non-empty dependency maps must continue to re-hash path by path while empty maps with explicit none scope bypass freshness checks
The manifest must emit a canonical byte-for-byte backward-compatible signed declaration 'file-scope: none' only when scope is none, preserving legacy paths and unscoped output
An authenticated none-scope declaration must not be suppressible by unauthenticated plaintext manipulation; tampered manifests must still return stale-head
Scope flips or file impact reason changes must invalidate none-scoped records as stale-material while preserving existing fingerprints for paths and unscoped tickets
Recovery via resign_plan_review must preserve none scope through the same signing boundary without branching logic in resign.py
